dz: 克莱尔沃的伯纳德在韦兹莱的田野上宣讲他著名的布道，敦促第二次十字军东征的必要性。路易七世出席并加入十字军东征。
de: Bernard of Clairvaux preaches his famous sermon in a field at Vézelay, urging the necessity of a Second Crusade. Louis VII is present, and joins the Crusade.

te: Seljuk atabeg Imad al-Din Zengi of Mosul is assassinated by a slave and succeeded by his quarrelling sons.
dz: 摩苏尔的Seljuk atabeg Imad al-Din Zengi被一名奴隶暗杀并被他争吵的儿子所继承.
de: Seljuk atabeg Imad al-Din Zengi of Mosul is assassinated by a slave and succeeded by his quarrelling sons.
